# Documentation for `scw domain`
Manage your domains and contacts.

## Contact management

Contact management.


### Check if contacts are compatible with a domain or a TLD

Check whether contacts are compatible with a domain or a TLD.
If contacts are not compatible with either the domain or the TLD, the information that needs to be corrected is returned.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain contact check-compatibility [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                                                                     | Description                                                                                          | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| domains.{index}                                                          | List of domains to check contacts compatibility against.                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| tlds.{index}                                                             | List of TLDs to check contacts compatibility against.                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact-id                                                         | ID of the existing contact to check as the domain's owner.                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.legal-form                                                 | Legal form of the contact (individual, corporate, association, other).                               | One of: `legal_form_unknown`, `individual`, `corporate`, `association`, `other`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.firstname                                                  | First name of the contact.                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.lastname                                                   | Last name of the contact.                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.company-name                                               | Company name of the contact (required for corporate legal forms).                                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.email                                                      | Email address of the contact.                                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.email-alt                                                  | Alternative email address of the contact.                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.phone-number                                               | Phone number of the contact, normalized to +CC.NationalNumber format.                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.fax-number                                                 | Fax number of the contact, normalized to +CC.NationalNumber format.                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.address-line-1                                             | First line of the contact's address.                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.address-line-2                                             | Second line of the contact's address.                                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.zip                                                        | Postal code of the contact.                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.city                                                       | City of the contact.                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### Get a contact

Retrieve a contact's details from the registrar using the given contact's ID.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain contact get [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name       | Description                    | Argument Specifications |
|------------|--------------------------------|-------------------------|
| contact-id | ID of the contact to retrieve. | Required                |



### List contacts

Retrieve the list of contacts and their associated domains and roles.
You can filter the list by domain name.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain contact list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name            | Description                                                  | Argument Specifications                                                         |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| domain          | Filter contacts by domain name.                              |                                                                                 |
| project-id      | Filter contacts by project ID.                               |                                                                                 |
| role            | Filter contacts by role (owner, administrative, technical).  | One of: `unknown_role`, `owner`, `administrative`, `technical`                  |
| email-status    | Filter contacts by email validation status.                  | One of: `email_status_unknown`, `validated`, `not_validated`, `invalid_email`   |
| order-by        | Sort order of the returned contacts                          | One of: `created_at_asc`, `created_at_desc`, `email_asc`, `email_desc`          |
| status          | Filter by contact status                                     | One of: `status_unknown`, `active`, `pending`                                   |
| legal-form      | Filter by legal form                                         | One of: `legal_form_unknown`, `individual`, `corporate`, `association`, `other` |
| email           | Filter by email address                                      |                                                                                 |
| search          | Fuzzy search in firstname, lastname, email, and company_name |                                                                                 |
| organization-id | Filter contacts by organization ID.                          |                                                                                 |



### Update contact

Edit the contact's information.

**Usage:**

```shell

```

## Domain management

Domain management.


### Disable auto renew

Disable the `auto renew` feature for a domain. This means the domain will not be renewed before its expiry date.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain disable-auto-renew [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                                | Argument Specifications |
|--------|--------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to disable auto renew for. | Required                |



### Disable a domain's DNSSEC

Disable DNSSEC for a domain.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain disable-dnssec [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                            | Argument Specifications |
|--------|----------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to disable DNSSEC for. | Required                |



### Enable auto renew

Enable the `auto renew` feature for a domain. This means the domain will be automatically renewed before its expiry date.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain enable-auto-renew [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                               | Argument Specifications |
|--------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to enable auto renew for. | Required                |



### Update domain DNSSEC

If your domain uses another registrar and has the default Scaleway NS, you have to **update the DS record at your registrar**.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain enable-dnssec [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                            | Description                                                       | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                          |
|---------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| domain                          | The domain name to enable DNSSEC for.                             | Required                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ds-record.key-id                | The key tag of the DS record.                                     |                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ds-record.algorithm             | The cryptographic algorithm of the DNSKEY used for the DS record. | One of: `rsamd5`, `dh`, `dsa`, `rsasha1`, `dsa_nsec3_sha1`, `rsasha1_nsec3_sha1`, `rsasha256`, `rsasha512`, `ecc_gost`, `ecdsap256sha256`, `ecdsap384sha384`, `ed25519`, `ed448` |
| ds-record.digest.type           | The digest type of the DS record.                                 | One of: `sha_1`, `sha_256`, `gost_r_34_11_94`, `sha_384`                                                                                                                         |
| ds-record.digest.digest         | The digest string of the DS record.                               |                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ds-record.digest.public-key.key | The public key string.                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ds-record.public-key.key        | The public key string.                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                  |



### Get domain

Retrieve a specific domain and display the domain's information.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain get [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                  | Argument Specifications |
|--------|------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to retrieve. | Required                |



### Get a domain's authorization code

Retrieve the authorization code to transfer an unlocked domain. The output returns an error if the domain is locked.
Some TLDs may have a different procedure to retrieve the authorization code. In that case, the information displays in the message field.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain get-auth-code [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                                             | Argument Specifications |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to retrieve the authorization code for. | Required                |



### List domains

Retrieve the list of domains you own.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name            | Description                                                                         | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                 |
|-----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| order-by        | Sort order of the returned domains.                                                 | One of: `domain_asc`, `domain_desc`                                                                                                                                                     |
| registrar       | Filter domains by registrar.                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| status          | Filter domains by status.                                                           | One of: `status_unknown`, `active`, `creating`, `create_error`, `renewing`, `renew_error`, `xfering`, `xfer_error`, `expired`, `expiring`, `updating`, `checking`, `locked`, `deleting` |
| project-id      | Filter domains by project ID.                                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| is-external     | Filter domains by whether they are external (not managed by Scaleway as registrar). |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| domain          | Filter domains by domain name.                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| organization-id | Filter domains by organization ID.                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                         |



### List domains that can be renewed

Retrieve the list of domains you own that can be renewed. You can also see the maximum renewal duration in years for your domains that are renewable.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain list-renewable [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name            | Description                                   | Argument Specifications             |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| order-by        | Sort order of the returned renewable domains. | One of: `domain_asc`, `domain_desc` |
| project-id      | Filter renewable domains by project ID.       |                                     |
| organization-id | Filter renewable domains by organization ID.  |                                     |



### Lock the transfer of a domain

Lock the transfer of a domain. This means that the domain cannot be transferred and the authorization code cannot be requested to your current registrar.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain lock-transfer [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                           | Argument Specifications |
|--------|---------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to lock for transfer. | Required                |



### Search available domains

Search a domain or a maximum of 10 domains that are available.

If the TLD list is empty or not set, the search returns the results from the most popular TLDs.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain search [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                | Description                                                              | Argument Specifications |
|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domains.{index}     | A list of domain to search, TLD is optional                              | Required                |
| tlds.{index}        | Array of tlds to search on                                               |                         |
| strict-search       | Search exact match                                                       |                         |
| include-exact-match | If an exact match is found, include it in response as a separate element |                         |



### Unlock the transfer of a domain

Unlock the transfer of a domain. This means that the domain can be transferred and the authorization code can be requested to your current registrar.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain unlock-transfer [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                             | Argument Specifications |
|--------|-----------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to unlock for transfer. | Required                |



### Update a domain's contacts

Update contacts for a specific domain or create a new contact.<br/>
If you add the same contact for multiple roles (owner, administrative, technical), only one ID will be created and used for all of the roles.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain domain update [arg=value ...]
```

| Name                                                                     | Description                                                                                          | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

| technical-contact.firstname                                              | First name of the contact.                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

## External domain management

External domain management.


### Delete an external domain

Delete an external domain name.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain external-domain delete [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                         | Argument Specifications |
|--------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The external domain name to delete. | Required                |



### Register an external domain

Request the registration of an external domain name.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain external-domain register [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name       | Description                                                              | Argument Specifications |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain     | The external domain name to register.                                    | Required                |
| project-id | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used |                         |



## Domain host management

Domain host management.


### Create a hostname for a domain

Create a hostname for a domain with glue IPs.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain host create [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name        | Description                                             | Argument Specifications |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain      | The domain name to create the hostname for.             | Required                |
| name        | The hostname to create.                                 |                         |
| ips.{index} | List of glue IP addresses associated with the hostname. |                         |



### Delete a domain's hostname

Delete a domain's hostname.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain host delete [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                                | Argument Specifications |
|--------|--------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name of the hostname to delete. | Required                |
| name   | The hostname to delete.                    | Required                |



### List a domain's hostnames

List a domain's hostnames using their glue IPs.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain host list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name   | Description                            | Argument Specifications |
|--------|----------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain | The domain name to list hostnames for. | Required                |



### Update a domain's hostname

Update a domain's hostname with glue IPs.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain host update [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name        | Description                                                           | Argument Specifications |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain      | The domain name of the hostname to update.                            | Required                |
| name        | The hostname to update.                                               | Required                |
| ips.{index} | New list of glue IP addresses associated with the hostname. Optional. |                         |



## Domain order operations

Domain order operations.


### Purchase domains

Request the registration of domain names.
You can provide a domain's already existing contact or a new contact.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain order buy [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

| duration-in-years                                                        | Duration in years for the domain registration. Subject to TLD-specific minimum and maximum constraints.                                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| project-id                                                               | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

| owner-contact.firstname                                                  | First name of the contact.                                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### Renew domains

Request the renewal of one or more domain names.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain order renew [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name               | Description                                                                                        | Argument Specifications |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domains.{index}    | List of domains to renew.                                                                          | Required                |
| duration-in-years  | Duration in years for the domain renewal. Subject to TLD-specific minimum and maximum constraints. |                         |
| force-late-renewal | Confirm the late renewal (incurs extra fees).                                                      |                         |



### Trade a domain's contact

Request to change a domain's contact owner.<br/>
If you specify the `organization_id` of the domain's new owner, the contact will change from the current owner's Scaleway account to the new owner's Scaleway account.<br/>
If the new owner's current contact information is not available, the first ever contact they have created for previous domains is taken into account to operate the change.<br/>
If the new owner has never created a contact to register domains before, an error message displays.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain order trade [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                                                                | Description                                                                                            | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| domain                                                              | The domain name to trade (change of owner/registrant).                                                 | Required                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| project-id                                                          | Project ID to associate with the domain after the trade. Also used to filter the new owner's contacts. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| new-owner-contact-id                                                | ID of the existing contact to use as the domain's new owner.                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| new-owner-contact.legal-form                                        | Legal form of the contact (individual, corporate, association, other).                                 | One of: `legal_form_unknown`, `individual`, `corporate`, `association`, `other`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| new-owner-contact.firstname                                         | First name of the contact.                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| new-owner-contact.lastname                                          | Last name of the contact.                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### Transfer a domain

Request the transfer of a domain from another registrar to Scaleway Domains and DNS.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain order transfer [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                                                                     | Description                                                                                          | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| domains.{index}.auth-code                                                |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

If none is passed the default project ID will be used                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact-id                                                         | ID of the existing contact to use as the domain's owner.                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.legal-form                                                 | Legal form of the contact (individual, corporate, association, other).                               | One of: `legal_form_unknown`, `individual`, `corporate`, `association`, `other`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.firstname                                                  | First name of the contact.                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| owner-contact.lastname                                                   | Last name of the contact.                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

## Task management

Task management.


### List tasks

List all operations performed on the account.
You can filter the list of tasks by domain name.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain task list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name             | Description                       | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|------------------|-----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| project-id       | Filter tasks by project ID.       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| domain           | Filter tasks by domain name.      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| types.{index}    | Filter tasks by type.             | One of: `unknown`, `create_domain`, `create_external_domain`, `renew_domain`, `transfer_domain`, `trade_domain`, `lock_domain_transfer`, `unlock_domain_transfer`, `enable_dnssec`, `disable_dnssec`, `update_domain`, `update_contact`, `delete_domain`, `cancel_task`, `generate_ssl_certificate`, `renew_ssl_certificate`, `send_message`, `delete_domain_expired`, `delete_external_domain`, `create_host`, `update_host`, `delete_host`, `move_project`, `transfer_online_domain` |
| statuses.{index} | Filter tasks by status.           | One of: `unavailable`, `new`, `waiting_payment`, `pending`, `success`, `error`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| order-by         | Sort order of the returned tasks. | One of: `domain_desc`, `domain_asc`, `type_asc`, `type_desc`, `status_asc`, `status_desc`, `updated_at_asc`, `updated_at_desc`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| organization-id  | Filter tasks by organization ID.  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |



### List inbound domain transfers

List all inbound transfer operations on the account.
You can filter the list of inbound transfers by domain name.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain task list-inbound-transfers [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name            | Description                                                                        | Argument Specifications |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| project-id      | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used           |                         |
| domain          | Filter inbound transfers by domain name.                                           |                         |
| organization-id | Organization ID to use. If none is passed the default organization ID will be used |                         |



### Retry the inbound transfer of a domain

Request a retry for the transfer of a domain from another registrar to Scaleway Domains and DNS.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain task retry-inbound-transfer [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name       | Description                                                              | Argument Specifications |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| domain     | The domain being transferred.                                            |                         |
| project-id | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used |                         |
| auth-code  | An optional new auth code to replace the previous one for the retry.     |                         |



## TLD management

TLD management.


### List TLD offers

Retrieve the list of TLDs and offers associated with them.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw domain tld list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name         | Description                     | Argument Specifications         |
|--------------|---------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| tlds.{index} | Array of TLDs to return         |                                 |
| order-by     | Sort order of the returned TLDs | One of: `name_asc`, `name_desc` |
